pool.text: New Zealand copra firm Henderson and Macfarlane established its regional headquarters on Majuro.
Cyprian Bridge of the British warship HMS Espiegle mediated a peace treaty.
The German Empire annexed and claimed Majuro Atoll for the German Protectorate.
The Imperial Japanese Navy captured Majuro during World War I.
United States Armed Forces invaded Majuro during World War II.
Majuro became the new country capital after breaking away from Micronesia.
Majuro retained its administrative center status after independence under a Compact.
The Marshall Islands Shipping Corporation was established by the Marshall Islands.
Witon Barry discussed coconut oil experimentation as an alternative to diesel fuel.
The service sector composed eighty-six percent of the GDP in Majuro.
The first mosque opened in Majuro in September of this year.
The Majuro Declaration was signed by the Pacific Islands Forum on climate change.
Most physicians employed by the Marshall Islands were located at the hospital.
Tuna transshipment moved hundreds of thousands of tons of tuna through the port.
